author: Samsung
description:
Samsung Design [Open Lab]

"Design is an act of love"

This exhibition is an open laboratory of design experiments exploring Samsung’s vision for the near future of technology.

Through concepts, prototypes, and immersive experiences, we explore a simple idea: technology should serve humanity—guided by AI × (EI + HI), where artificial intelligence is shaped by emotional intelligence and human imagination, and becomes an enabler of empathy, creativity, and human potential.

Here, form and function follow meaning, creating experiences that elevate life and help people live longer, live better, live loud, and live on.

Welcome to The Human Side of Tech.

Superstudio (Via Tortona 27 Milano)
20-26 April, 11:00 to 18:00

#SamsungDesignOpenLab #MilanDesignWeek2026 #MDW2026 #SamsungDesign
title: 2026 MDW Samsung Design [Open Lab] Teaser Video

description:
This video shows how Bespoke AI wisely bridges the differences between a couple who are polar opposites.
There is no need to worry when two different worlds come together under one roof.
Bespoke AI smartly manages your different tastes, temperatures, and routines, reducing household chores
and giving you more time to focus on each other.
Experience a completely new couple life like never before with Bespoke AI.
The Bespoke AI Refrigerator Family Hub smartly manages different tastes and ingredient preferences
to suggest the optimal meal plan for both of you.
You can control and enjoy every aspect of your kitchen life right from the 9-inch AI HOME screen.
Even if your clothing styles differ, the Bespoke AI Laundry Combo automatically detects the fabric
to handle washing and drying in a single go using the optimal mode.
Meanwhile, the Bespoke AI WindFreePro finds the perfectly comfortable temperature for both individuals,
providing peaceful relaxation without clashing over the thermostat
title: Your Life stage: Couple｜Bespoke AI｜Samsung
